caption: The drawing features an ornate, oval picture frame rendered in muted colors with accents of green, red, blue, brown, and gold. At the top center of the frame, there is a detailed eagle with wings partially spread, standing above an oval medallion that displays the profile of a head. Beneath the eagle and around the top of the frame are intricate scroll and floral decorations. The sides of the frame display symmetrical tassel- and leaf-like ornaments that extend vertically. At the bottom center of the frame, there is a shield with a blue upper section filled with white stars and red and white vertical stripes on the lower part, flanked by green leaves and berries. The frame is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or patterns present.
title: Picture Frame
